gate_comparisons.attribution: Inspect matched noinfo/tie/error/ablation actions and outcomes. If they contradict semantic attribution or incremental mechanism, numeric core thresholds alone cannot yield full pass.
gate_comparisons.candidate_increment: core relationship shift: shared_semantic versus bayes_semantic; relative difference of means >=2%, positive J difference in >=4/6 parents, no parent >50% of summed positive J differences
gate_comparisons.coverage_guard: For each core comparison S/G nominal, S/B shifted and S/B nominal: mean C_nav difference >=-0.01
gate_comparisons.reliable_noninferiority: core nominal: shared_semantic versus bayes_semantic; mean J relative difference >=-1%
gate_comparisons.return_guard: For each same comparison, S return rate must not be lower; all attempted task outcomes retained
gate_comparisons.semantic_information: core nominal: shared_semantic versus G; relative difference of means >=5%
gate_comparisons.uncertainty: These are finite development investment gates, not confirmatory statistical significance
gate_comparisons.zero_denominator: Baseline mean J=0 makes relative difference undefined; report absolute difference and do not pass a relative gate automatically

analysis_rules.known_uniform_prior_boundary: Existing algebraic tests only; not substituted for actual uninformed relation trajectories.
analysis_rules.metric: J_nav=C_nav*equal-facility exterior F1@5cm; full prediction mesh; missed facilities retained. .3m is surface-evaluation quadrature spacing; TSDF voxel .04m; matching distance threshold .05m.
analysis_rules.missing_or_failed: Keep every attempted slot, separate technical failures from task outcomes. Do not invent missing J=0; report complete-pair counts and sensitivity bounds. Core gate cannot pass with missing required pairs.
analysis_rules.paired_effects: For each fixed parent/condition compute absolute J differences and relative differences; development gates use relative difference of means, not mean of ratios.
analysis_rules.robustness_limit: No-information/recognition/ablations use two parents; budget/tie use one. These are mechanism boundary diagnostics, not six-parent robustness claims.
analysis_rules.singleton_class_boundary: Use the observed-history boundary in integration DEV_A_G/B/S: at most one qualified observed instance per category. The physical task contains two cabinets, but they did not both enter qualified shared belief. This is not a true singleton-class scene or independent primary parent. Mathematical single-instance equivalence remains separately tested.
analysis_rules.stopping: One candidate plus at most one diagnosed bounded correction; compare implementations separately. No expansion to achieve positive effects. Required matrix or a declared integrity/resource stop must be reported truthfully.
analysis_rules.unit: parent layout; condition/budget/tie/recognition variants do not increase n

limits: This is finite development progress; no independent held-out confirmation.
Metrics require an original complete review or a separately reverified exact-input reuse chain with independent target replay; missing values remain null.
Reused endpoint numbers are labeled reused and do not claim another numerical evaluator execution.
Retired negative episodes retain their own archived executed sources and are never mixed into current-phase core comparisons.
Same-layout conditions/budgets/ties do not increase independent parent count.
Positive total EVI plus cross-future enablement does not identify net cross-instance value.
Action divergence or positive forecasts alone do not establish measured semantic benefit.
Numeric core gates cannot settle noinfo/tie/error/ablation attribution or issue a final route decision.
Unreviewed manifest pins are observed snapshots checked against durable result/source/input bindings, not independent replay evidence.
P03 facility-0 fixed-view failures remain; the static 192-frame check is not a paid planner trajectory.
